originalProposals.reason: Two-strap backpack load distribution is real posture safety, but G5-F-4 gravity-as-non-contact is not admitted (needs non-contact|without touch). G3-F-1:pull is people pulling objects, not gravitational pull; G5-F-5 is heavier/lighter falling; G8-E-11 is tides; G8-F-9 is falling-energy conservation; G7-F-1 interaction does not teach measuring forces. TL hatak ng gravity / BIS pull sa gravity OK. Potential G5-F-4 after a backpack-load/gravity facet, or a health/spine-safety facet.

Groundwater occupying pores and cracks rather than underground rivers is sound (USGS aquifers: https://www.usgs.gov/special-topics/water-science-school/science/aquifers-and-groundwater). G4-E-1 soil-type water-holding is not admitted; G5-E-6 water-cycle processes need evap/condens or plant/animal/environment; G3-E-1 school locate-and-describe is a guided activity and is not credited; G8-L-8 water-cycle flow charts are not credited. TL/BIS pores/cracks OK. Potential G5-E-6 after a groundwater-storage facet.

Soap disrupting a virus lipid envelope is real for enveloped viruses (CDC handwashing). G9-L-3:virus is mutations caused by infectious agents, not destroying virions; G9-M-2 bond-break is not admitted; G4-M-3 burn/react/biodegradable is not taught. TL pumapatay / BIS makaguba keep the mechanism. Potential G9-L-3 after a virus-envelope/hygiene facet, or G4-M-3 after soap-as-chemical-action.

Rocks near a volcano can be hot from magma, but G7-F-9:conduction needs the word conduction not conducts (pattern miss). G5-F-9:conductors is electrical circuit testing; G6-E-1:magma is volcano formation; G4-F-9:forms would swallow conduction into generic heat-causes-change; G4-F-10 is school/home/community heat uses. TL dumadaloy ang init / BIS nagagikan ang kainit describe heat flow without naming conduction. Potential G7-F-9 after conducts/conduction.

Thermal energy flowing from warm drink to cooler ice (not cold flowing in) is sound heat-transfer direction. G7-F-8:heat-transfer needs heat.*(transfer|flow) — EN says thermal energy flows (pattern miss). G7-F-9:advantage matches warm but does not name conduction/convection/radiation; G6-M-2:cooling matches cool without teaching change of state. TL/BIS thermal energy mo-flow/dumadaloy OK. Potential G7-F-8 after a thermal-energy-flow matcher.

Ice absorbing heat rather than releasing coldness is the same hot-to-cold teaching. G6-M-2 heating/cooling admit absorb heat / cool, but melting as a change of state is not taught; G7-F-8 is not admitted; G10-M-9 absorb is exo/endothermic chemical reactions; G5-M-4 ice/liquid is state-ID swallow. TL sini-sipsip / BIS nagsuyop OK. Potential G7-F-8, or G6-M-2 after melting-by-heat-absorption.

Helium is about 7× less dense than air (~0.178 vs ~1.225 kg/m³), so balloons float. No density/buoyancy facet admits it. G3-M-3 balloons are science equipment; G4-E-7 helium is Sun composition; G8-M-6 helium is periodic-table names; G5-M-4 gas/air is state-ID swallow. TL mas magaan = lighter, not less dense; BIS density OK. Potential new density/buoyancy facet (same destination as buoyancy-helium-balloon).

Honey viscosity thousands of times that of water is a fair order of magnitude (~10³–10⁴ mPa·s vs ~1). No viscosity facet. G5-M-3 is shape and volume; G5-M-4 liquid water is state ID; G7-M-4 liquid is particle diagrams; G9-F-7 resistan is electrical resistance. TL malapot OK but matibay sa pagdaloy = durable, not flow-resistant; BIS viscous/lisod mo-flow OK. Potential new viscosity/liquid-flow facet.

Exhaled water vapor condensing as visible fog is real. G6-M-1:condensation is not admitted (EN lacks condens; TL/BIS add nagko-condense/mo-condense). G6-M-5:water-vapor is air as a four-gas mixture, not breath fog; G6-M-2 cooling is not admitted. TL usok = smoke, not fog; BIS hamog OK. Potential G6-M-1 after breath-condensation (and EN condens).

Ice is less dense than liquid water (~0.917 g/cm³), so cubes float. No density/buoyancy facet. G5-M-4 solid/liquid names states only inside a density claim, not classifying home objects; G5-M-3 is shape/volume; G7-M-4 diagrams are not credited; G10-E-8 ice/glacier is climate evidence. TL/BIS less dense OK. Potential new density/buoyancy facet.

Mayfly adults are short-lived, but 'only twenty-four hours, the shortest of any insect' overclaims: Dolania americana females live ~5 minutes (UF Book of Insect Records: https://entnemdept.ufl.edu/walker/ufbir/chapters/chapter_37.shtml). G4-L-5 flow-chart life-cycle comparison is not admitted; investigation hits are not credited; G5-L-4:insects is table classification, not adult-lifespan trivia. TL/BIS 24 oras OK. Potential G4-L-5 after a mayfly-stage facet with copy repair.

A honeybee's barbed stinger can remain and keep pumping venom. G3-L-4 is not admitted (needs legs/wings/feeding parts or fin/tail, not a stinger) and the competency roles are move/gather food, not defense. Weather after and rest hits are keyword traps. TL sinaksak = stabbed, not stung; BIS 'mosakit ka sa honeybee' is awkward. Potential G3-L-4 after a stinger/defense body-part facet.

Typhoon winds can uproot trees, but EN says mechanical energy while TL/BIS say kinetic energy (meaning mismatch). G8-F-4 kinetic is not admitted (needs kinetic in EN); G8-F-8 mechanical-as-sum is not admitted; G3-F-1:wind is ways to make objects move, not cyclone destruction (see typhoon-wind-damage hold). Potential G8-F-4/F-8 after EN/TL/BIS aligned, or G5-E-8 after wind|tree damage.

Crowbar MA = effort/load arm = 1.5/0.5 = 3 is correct, but G6-F-2:levers needs lever not crowbar/fulcrum (pattern miss). G6-F-3 force/effort/test is not admitted; G7-F-9 advantage is heat transfer. TL/BIS keep fulcrum/mechanical advantage. Potential G6-F-2 after crowbar/fulcrum/mechanical-advantage.

c ≈ 299,792 km/s and ~7.5 Earth-equator crossings per second is fair (equator ~40,075 km). G9-F-10 vacuum is EMR as charged-particle transverse waves, not a speed trivia; G4-F-4 speed graphs are not taught; G4-F-10 uses of light are not taught. TL/BIS keep vacuum and km/s. Potential G9-F-10 after speed-of-light-in-vacuum.

Reflective tape sending car headlights back to the driver is how light behaves (G3-F-6:behavior reflect) and a community use of light for visibility (G4-F-10:light). Guided-exploration is not admitted and is not credited. G4-F-8 non-contact is not claimed; G4-F-9 because/cause and forms are keyword; G6-F-5 ripple-tank reflection is an investigation and is not credited; G8-F-11 plane-mirror is not admitted. TL nire-reflect / BIS nag-reflect keep reflect. Full EN/TL/BIS and both pools inspected; single identical card ID.

evidence.quote: wearing reflective tape at night make you visible

originalProposals.reason: A straw looking bent because light slows and changes direction in water is everyday refraction, but G8-F-11 needs plane/curved mirror, glass block, lens, or prism (pattern miss on straw/water). G3-F-6:behavior is not admitted (no reflect/shadow/block/through); G6-F-5:bending is ripple-tank water waves and is not credited. BIS mokurot = pinch, not bend; TL yumuyuko = bow is OK-ish. Potential G8-F-11 after refraction/everyday-straw, with BIS repair.

Lightning on the order of 10^8 V vs a 230 V PH outlet (~1.3 million times) is a fair comparison. G3-E-5:danger is weather danger, not a voltage trivia; G4-E-6:safety is extreme-weather precautions, not taught; G9-F-6 electron-flow/electrical safety is not admitted. TL/BIS volts/saksakan OK. Potential G3-E-5/G4-E-6 after lightning-danger, or G9-F-6 after high-voltage safety.

Moon surface gravity ≈ 1/6 of Earth's is true. G5-F-4 non-contact is not admitted; G8-E-11 is tides; G8-F-9 is falling-energy conservation; G3-F-1:pull is people pulling; G7-F-1 interaction does not teach lunar vs Earth weight. TL isang-anim / BIS usa ka-unom OK. Potential G5-F-4 after gravity-varies-by-body.

45.5 T continuous field (NHMFL 2019) vs a ~5 mT fridge magnet is about 9,000×. G4-F-8 is non-contact attraction, not field-strength trivia; G4-F-7 poles/materials/investigation is not admitted; G5-F-10 is electromagnet observations; G6-M-6 is magnetic separation. TL/BIS Tesla/ref magnet OK. Potential G4-F-7 after a magnet-strength facet.

Crushing or dissolving a time-release pill can dump the dose. G7-M-10 solubility-by-heat is not admitted; G7-M-8 solute/solvent is not admitted; G4-M-5 is minimizing burning waste and handling reactive materials; G3-M-6 harmful environmental changes is not admitted. TL/BIS time-release/overdose OK. Potential new medication-safety facet, or G7-M-10 after dissolving-rate.

Mercury is a liquid metal at room temperature and its vapor is toxic; do not touch a broken thermometer. G8-M-4 fixed composition/proton number is not admitted; G5-M-2 three states is not taught; G4-M-3 burn/react/biodegradable is not admitted; G8-M-6 mercury is not in the first 20 elements. TL/BIS toxic vapors OK. Potential G8-M-6 after a mercury-element/safety facet, or G4-M-5 handling reactive materials.

Marble is metamorphosed limestone, but Bolinao is a limestone terrain (Bolinao Limestone; National Museum geological papers), not a marble-producing town — Romblon is the marble province. Even if repaired, G5-E-2 texture/color/grain and G5-E-3 dichotomous key are not admitted; G6-E-1 is volcano formation. TL/BIS marble/limestone OK. Potential G5-E-3 after copy repair to a real marble locality.

Whole milk ~87% water and ~3.5% fat as a colloid is standard. G6-M-4 solutions/suspensions are not admitted (colloid is neither); G6-M-4:uses is not admitted. TL gatas / BIS gatas keep colloidal mixture. Potential G6-M-4 after a colloid facet.

Inhaled crystalline silica (quartz) dust can cause silicosis; protective masks are required. G5-L-2 respiratory parts are not admitted (lungs unit needs oxygen and blood/CO2); G5-E-2 rock features is wrong; G3-M-8:cutting is making solids useful by cutting, not dust harm; G7-M-12 is lab equipment. TL/BIS protective masks/baga OK. Potential G5-L-2 after silica-dust/lungs, or G4-M-5.

Soil mixed with water for rice is a real mixture example, but G6-M-4 uniform/non-uniform solutions/suspensions are not admitted. G6-L-8 nonliving-interactions would swallow a mixture card into ecosystem good/harm; G6-L-7 does not identify biotic/abiotic factors. TL/BIS mixture/soil/water OK. Potential G6-M-4 after a soil-water-suspension facet.

Synchronous rotation (one spin per orbit) is true tidal locking. G5-E-12 phases via Earth-Moon-Sun model is not admitted (needs sun+earth+moon or model/draw); G6-E-8 is seasons/eclipses/SEM model; G6-E-7 is Earth rotation for day/night. TL/BIS umiikot/nag-ikot sa axis OK. Potential G5-E-12 after moon-rotation/tidal-locking.

The South Sea pearl is the Philippine national gem and forms in Pinctada maxima. G4-L-4 habitat table is not admitted; G6-L-4 vertebrate/invertebrate local examples does not teach backbone; G3-E-2 is useful things from non-living materials (a pearl is from a living oyster). TL pambansang hiyas / BIS nasudnong hiyas OK. Potential G6-L-4 after oyster-as-invertebrate, or a PH-national-symbols/mollusk facet.

Sensory nerves carrying signals from skin to brain as touch is sound. G8-L-2 needs digestion+excretion together or models/flowcharts/diagrams (not admitted; diagram facet is not credited). TL/BIS sensory nerve/electrical signals OK. Potential G8-L-2 after a nervous-system/sensory pathway.

Mean ocean salinity ~3.5% by mass is standard. G6-M-4 solution/homogeneous is not admitted; G7-M-8 solute/solvent is not admitted; G10-M-2 saline is acids/bases/salts with indicators; G7-M-11 is home/school litmus. TL/BIS dissolved salt/asin OK. Potential G6-M-4/G7-M-8 after seawater-as-solution.

Cornstarch + water as a dilatant (non-Newtonian) fluid is real. G6-M-4 solutions/suspensions are not admitted. G5-M-4 acts-solid swallows a non-Newtonian counterexample into three-state ID. TL tumitigas kapag binato = hardens when thrown; BIS tapakan = when stepped on — force applied, not exact. Potential G6-M-4 after a cornstarch-water mixture, or a non-Newtonian facet.

Molting replaces feathers without changing their chemistry, a physical change, but G6-M-3 identity/reversibility is not admitted (needs physical.*substance|identity, no new substance, or revers; composition-unchanged is a pattern miss). G5-L-4:birds is feather classification; G8-M-4 is pure-substance fixed composition. TL/BIS chemical composition OK. Potential G6-M-3 after a composition-unchanged matcher.

Slicing mango without a new substance is a physical change, but G6-M-3 is not admitted (same composition-unchanged pattern miss). G3-M-8:cutting is not admitted (slicing ≠ cut); G8-M-4 is pure substances. TL paghiwa-hi looks truncated from paghiwa-hiwa; BIS pag-slice OK. Potential G6-M-3 after composition-unchanged; G3-M-8 after slice/cut.

Shredding buko without changing composition is a physical change, but G6-M-3 is not admitted (composition-unchanged pattern miss). G3-M-8:cutting is not admitted (shred ≠ cut) and the competency is making solids useful, not naming physical vs chemical change. TL/BIS identical/nagpabilin OK. Potential G6-M-3 after composition-unchanged; G3-M-8 after shred/cut-to-useful.

Methuselah bristlecone is over 4,800 years (USFS ~4,850). G5-L-6 life-cycle comparison is not admitted; G3-L-3 grow/respond/reproduce is not admitted; G9-E-5 geologic dating is a keyword age trap. TL/BIS 4,800 taon/tuig OK. Potential new life-span/oldest-organism facet, not current core.

Plasma is the most common baryonic state of matter in the universe, but G5-M-2 is the three states (solids, liquids, gases). G3-F-5:uses matches see as a keyword trap. TL/BIS estado ng matter OK. Potential G5-M-2 after a fourth-state/plasma enrichment, not current core.

Vesicular pumice can float; 'only type of rock' is a school simplification (some scoria can too). G5-E-2 texture/color/grain is not admitted; G5-E-3 dichotomous key is not admitted; G3-E-1 school locate is a guided activity; G5-F-5 is heavier/lighter falling. TL/BIS lumutang/makalutaw OK. Potential G5-E-2 after density/texture of vesicular rocks.

Acasta Gneiss ~4.03 Ga (Canada) is a standard oldest-rock figure. G9-E-5 relative/absolute dating is not admitted (needs relative|superposition, absolute|radiometric, or time|age — 'years old' misses age); G9-E-6 geologic time scale is not admitted. TL/BIS 4.03 billion years OK. Potential G9-E-5 after an oldest-rock/absolute-age example.

Igneous/sedimentary/metamorphic formation is the rock cycle, but G5-E-2 is observe texture/color/grain and G5-E-3 is dichotomous-key classification from samples. G6-E-1 magma/formation is volcanoes; G9-E-3 transform is plate boundaries. TL/BIS tatlong paraan/tulo ka paagi OK. Potential G5-E-3 after formation-based classification (not a key).

Romblon marble from limestone is true, but G5-E-2 texture/color/grain and G5-E-3 dichotomous key are not admitted; G6-E-1 is volcano formation. TL/BIS metamorphic/limestone OK. Potential G5-E-3 after marble-as-metamorphic without requiring a key.
